name: Cloak of Veiled Shadows
label: Quest
description: Cloak of Veiled Shadows: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, friend. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, adventurer.
I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
I promise you won't be disappointed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring the materials for the cloak, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes... This drape is immaculate.
Take this cloak, friend. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.
